questions.question_text: Why are privacy settings important for teens on social media?

options.text: They make your posts look cooler and get more likes
They control who can see your content and personal info, protecting you from unwanted attention
They automatically delete old posts to keep your profile clean
They are only useful for professional platforms like LinkedIn

correct_answer.text: They control who can see your content and personal info, protecting you from unwanted attention

questions.question_text: What is a key reason to think before posting content online?

options.text: Posts can be permanent and impact your future, like college or job opportunities
Posting quickly gets you more followers instantly
Only public accounts need to worry about what they share
Deleted posts are gone forever and can’t be seen by anyone

correct_answer.text: Posts can be permanent and impact your future, like college or job opportunities

questions.question_text: What is a recommended step to handle cyberbullying or negative comments on social media?

options.text: Reply angrily to show you’re not affected by the comments
Ignore it completely and hope it goes away on its own
Save evidence, block/report the user, and talk to a trusted person for support
Delete your account to avoid any further issues

correct_answer.text: Save evidence, block/report the user, and talk to a trusted person for support

questions.question_text: How can teens protect themselves from online scams and predators?

options.text: Share personal info only with people who seem nice online
Keep personal info private, verify strangers, and trust their gut if something feels off
Accept all friend requests to build a bigger online network
Click on links promising free prizes to test if they’re real

correct_answer.text: Keep personal info private, verify strangers, and trust their gut if something feels off
